import unittest

from solution import duplicate_bundle


class DuplicateBundleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_deep_copy_makes_mutable_objects_independent(self):
        bundle = [
            {"name": "one", "nested": {"values": [1, 2]}},
            {"name": "two", "tags": {"a", "b"}},
        ]
        result = duplicate_bundle(bundle)
        self.assertEqual(result, bundle)
        self.assertIsNot(result, bundle)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], bundle[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["nested"], bundle[0]["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["nested"]["values"], bundle[0]["nested"]["values"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1]["tags"], bundle[1]["tags"])
        result[0]["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        result[1]["tags"].add("c")
        self.assertEqual(bundle[0]["nested"]["values"], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(bundle[1]["tags"], {"a", "b"})

    def test_aliasing_across_paths_and_top_level_entries_is_preserved(self):
        shared_list = [{"value": 1}]
        shared_dict = {"left": shared_list, "right": shared_list}
        bundle = [shared_dict, shared_dict]
        result = duplicate_bundle(bundle)
        self.assertIs(result[0], result[1])
        self.assertIs(result[0]["left"], result[0]["right"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], shared_dict)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["left"], shared_list)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["left"][0], shared_list[0])

    def test_cycles_are_cloned_without_pointing_to_input(self):
        item = {}
        item["self"] = item
        result = duplicate_bundle([item])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], item)
        self.assertIs(result[0]["self"], result[0])

    def test_input_is_not_mutated(self):
        shared = [1]
        bundle = [{"a": shared}, {"b": shared}]
        duplicate_bundle(bundle)
        self.assertEqual(bundle, [{"a": [1]}, {"b": [1]}])
        self.assertIs(bundle[0]["a"], bundle[1]["b"])

    def test_empty_returns_distinct_empty_list(self):
        bundle = []
        result = duplicate_bundle(bundle)
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        self.assertIsNot(result, bundle)

    def test_validation(self):
        for value in (None, (), {}, "items"):
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                duplicate_bundle(value)
        for bundle in ([{} , 1], ["bad"], [[], {}]):
            with self.subTest(bundle=bundle), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                duplicate_bundle(bundle)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
